scope: Research design only. No Study 1 model training, tuning, final evaluation, or sealed-final label inspection is authorized by this artifact.
research_question: Can an evidence-bound Decision Assurance Layer improve selective reliability and reduce unsafe clinical-task commitments while preserving useful coverage, relative to matched non-DAL baselines, on an untouched external FHIR medical-QA evaluation?

claim_boundary.candidate_contribution: A preregistered evidence-bound decision-assurance system integrating bounded action authorization, evidence-aware assurance, optional single-cycle controlled revision, and machine-verifiable evidence/claim governance.
not_claimed_as_novel: conformal or selective risk control alone
medical RAG or evidence provenance alone

late_breaking_methods_delta.title: Conformal Selective Prediction with General Risk Control
late_breaking_methods_delta.role: methodological risk-control comparator and design reference
late_breaking_methods_delta.implication: Finite-sample selective risk control is prior art; DAL may not claim risk-control novelty merely from thresholding or conformal selection.

late_breaking_methods_delta.title: Hierarchical Group-Conditional Conformal Risk Control for Selective Prediction in Language Models
late_breaking_methods_delta.implication: Marginal risk can conceal subgroup over-exposure; Study 1 must report group-conditional or worst-group descriptive risk where sample size permits.

late_breaking_methods_delta.title: Causal evidence that language models use confidence to drive behaviour
late_breaking_methods_delta.implication: Internal calibrated confidence and verbal confidence are distinct; verbal self-confidence cannot be treated as a sufficient reliability signal.

late_breaking_methods_delta.title: The evidence challenge facing large language models in medicine
late_breaking_methods_delta.implication: Rapid model change and heterogeneous evaluation require explicit versioning, bounded claims, and reproducible evidence generation.

hypotheses.statement: The D7-selected DAL-family system will have lower answer-correctness AURC than the matched QA-plus-confidence-abstention baseline on the sealed FHIR-AgentBench final split.
hypotheses.success_rule: The paired patient-cluster bootstrap estimate for DAL minus matched confidence-abstention AURC is below zero and its two-sided 95% percentile interval lies entirely below zero.

hypotheses.statement: At prespecified target coverages 0.50, 0.70, and 0.80, the D7-selected DAL-family system will not increase selective risk relative to the matched confidence-abstention baseline.

Under preregistered gold-resource suppression stress conditions, the D7-selected DAL-family system will reduce unsafe-commit rate relative to the matched non-DAL selective baseline while preserving the full-evidence reference condition.
Template- and resource-family subgroup reporting will not reveal a concentrated failure mode that is hidden by the marginal primary result.

final_split_rationale: The patient-level role assignment was created deterministically before final-label inspection and remains digest-bound.
Study 0 requested the 173-row FHIR final surface but completed zero rows because execution was interface-blocked-preexecution; no final performance was observed.
The 54 non-test patients contributed Study 0 calibration/validation rows and therefore cannot provide a cleaner blind final patient cohort than the preserved 40-patient test role.
The upstream benchmark is public, so foundation-model pretraining contamination remains a reported validity threat even though DAL development remains blind to the governed final labels.
Study 1 reuses the exact governed membership and does not create a favorable replacement split.

fhir_validation.role: development validation and model selection only

study0_pubmedqa.role: pilot diagnosis and optional development diagnostics only

additional_public_data.eligibility: development-only unless separately governed before use
requirements: no overlap with governed FHIR final patients
no use to alter the sealed final membership

local_fhir_execution.goal: Remove the Study 0 GCP interface blocker without changing FHIR-AgentBench task semantics.
local_fhir_execution.data_source: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo on FHIR v2.1.0
local_fhir_execution.adapter_scope: read-only FHIR R4 search compatibility for query patterns actually exercised by the benchmark
qualification_acceptance: Use only the 341 calibration and 1122 validation rows during adapter qualification.
Exercise every FHIR query pattern observed on governed non-test roles.
Require deterministic request parsing and stable resource-ID serialization.
Compare local retrieval against governed development-role expected FHIR resource IDs without consulting sealed-test supervision.
Any unsupported query semantic that can change benchmark behavior blocks D2 closeout until resolved without final-row access.
local_fhir_execution.semantic_drift_rule: If local compatibility cannot be proven on non-test roles, the FHIR final path remains blocked; paid GCP is not an automatic substitute.

mandatory_baselines.name: QA
mandatory_baselines.definition: The matched base QA system produces an answer on every evaluable row with no calibration-derived action policy and no DAL layer.

mandatory_baselines.name: QA + calibration
mandatory_baselines.definition: The identical base QA system exposes a held-out-calibrated correctness score but still commits its base answer; this isolates calibration quality from action selection.

mandatory_baselines.name: QA + confidence abstention
mandatory_baselines.definition: The identical base QA system uses only its frozen calibrated correctness score and calibration-derived thresholds to abstain at prespecified target coverages. No evidence-assurance features or revision are permitted.

mandatory_baselines.name: QA + DAL assurance
mandatory_baselines.definition: The matched QA system is wrapped by the D7-selected evidence-bound DAL assurance policy. The base answer generator, retrieval surface, and final-row inputs remain matched to the non-DAL comparators.

mandatory_baselines.name: QA + DAL-R controlled revision
mandatory_baselines.definition: DAL may trigger at most one additional bounded evidence-retrieval/revision cycle before final commit, abstain, or escalate.
mandatory_baselines.activation_rule: DAL-R may remain inactive if D5 development evidence does not support it; that decision must be frozen before D8 and cannot change after final access.

methodological_comparators.definition: A reproducible post-hoc conformal/selective risk-control comparator, using a published method such as SCoRE or a technically equivalent open implementation, must be assessed during D5 if its assumptions and implementation can be validated without paid resources.
methodological_comparators.final_status_rule: By D8 it must be either exact-method-frozen or explicitly not-applicable with evidence; it may never be improvised after final access.

methodological_comparators.definition: Verbalized self-confidence may be reported as exploratory only and cannot replace probability/logit-derived or validated assurance signals.

primary_endpoint.name: answer-correctness AURC
primary_endpoint.unit: row-level prediction with patient-clustered uncertainty analysis
primary_endpoint.definition: Area under the risk-coverage curve formed by ranking evaluable final rows by the system's frozen authorization/confidence score; risk is answer error among committed rows and coverage is committed rows divided by the fixed final denominator.
primary_endpoint.failure_aware_ranking: Rows without a valid output are assigned correctness 0 and a deterministic score below every valid output solely for primary metric construction, so failures cannot lower AURC by disappearing from the fixed denominator. Operational commit coverage is reported separately.
primary_endpoint.tie_handling: Equal authorization/confidence scores enter the risk-coverage curve as one block; no favorable row-order tie breaking is permitted.
primary_endpoint.integration: Trapezoidal area over the blockwise risk-coverage points from coverage 0 to 1 under the failure-aware ranking rule.

secondary_endpoints.name: selective risk at target coverage
secondary_endpoints.rule: Report target and achieved coverage; never relabel an unattained target as attained.
secondary_endpoints.threshold_source: Thresholds are fitted and frozen from the calibration role only; final labels never choose or adjust thresholds.

secondary_endpoints.name: unsafe-commit rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: incorrect committed answers divided by the fixed eligible-row denominator

secondary_endpoints.name: coverage
secondary_endpoints.definition: committed answers divided by the fixed eligible-row denominator

secondary_endpoints.name: full-commit answer correctness
secondary_endpoints.definition: upstream-normalized answer correctness for systems/conditions that commit
secondary_endpoints.role: utility context, not a replacement for selective metrics

secondary_endpoints.name: FHIR resource retrieval precision and recall
secondary_endpoints.definition: upstream FHIR-AgentBench resource-retrieval metrics using the frozen evaluator

secondary_endpoints.name: calibration
secondary_endpoints.eligibility: only when the compared score is a valid probability-like confidence and the calibration procedure was frozen before final access

exploratory_endpoints: revision-trigger rate and revision success when DAL-R is active
latency and CPU resource use on the frozen local execution path

evidence_stress_protocol.purpose: Test whether assurance behavior changes when benchmark-linked evidence availability is mechanically degraded, without claiming that the transformation fully represents real clinical ambiguity.

conditions.definition: For rows with at least two benchmark gold FHIR resource IDs, remove a deterministic hash-ordered half of those gold resources before the system receives evidence; rows with fewer than two gold resources are not assigned to this condition.
Remove all benchmark gold FHIR resource IDs from the evidence presented to the system.
Add a fixed-size deterministic hash-selected set of non-gold same-patient FHIR resources available through the frozen local store, without removing the original evidence.

evidence_stress_protocol.construction_boundary: The transformation algorithm is frozen before D9. Gold IDs for sealed rows may be consumed only by the final-evaluation harness after final authorization and must not be exposed to model selection, threshold fitting, prompt tuning, or human inspection.
evidence_stress_protocol.interpretation_boundary: These are benchmark-linked evidence-availability stress conditions, not proof of clinical contradiction robustness or real-world causal evidence sufficiency.

action_semantics.commit: Return the current answer as authorized.
action_semantics.abstain: Withhold an answer because the frozen authorization policy does not permit commitment.
action_semantics.revise: If DAL-R is active and its single revision budget is unused, trigger exactly one bounded evidence/reasoning revision cycle.
action_semantics.escalate: Return a bounded non-answer indicating that human or external review is required; escalation counts as non-commit for coverage metrics.

failure_accounting.interface_failures: counted and reported; never silently removed
failure_accounting.parse_failures: counted and reported; never silently removed
failure_accounting.timeouts: counted and reported; never silently removed
failure_accounting.oom: counted and reported; never silently removed
failure_accounting.missing_outputs: counted as failed rows for completion accounting

statistical_plan.bootstrap_rule: Sample the 40 sealed patients with replacement and retain all eligible rows belonging to each sampled patient; compute paired system differences within the same resample.
statistical_plan.primary_inference: H1 uses the preregistered directional success rule on the paired AURC difference.
statistical_plan.secondary_inference: Report paired estimates and 95% patient-cluster bootstrap intervals without converting post-hoc secondary findings into primary significance claims.
statistical_plan.p_values: No primary p-value is required or may be invented post hoc. If a later exact p-value construction is desired, it must be separately preregistered before D9.
statistical_plan.multiplicity: One primary endpoint. Secondary and exploratory endpoints are clearly labeled and are not promoted based on favorable results.
statistical_plan.small_groups: Subgroups with fewer than 10 sealed rows are reported only descriptively or pooled under a preregistered parent grouping; no unstable subgroup superiority claim is permitted.

allowed_candidate_requirements: open-weight or otherwise fully zero-cost locally runnable
license compatible with research release and reproducibility
exact model revision and tokenizer revision can be frozen
base-model release date and known benchmark exposure are recorded
architecture fits the compute envelope or has a validated quantized CPU inference path
candidate_model_policy.preferred_scale: small enough for reproducible CPU inference; approximately <=4B dense parameters is the default design envelope unless D3 proves an alternative zero-cost path
candidate_model_policy.contamination_policy: A model released before the FHIR-AgentBench public benchmark release is preferred when technically competitive, but release date is only a contamination-risk proxy and not proof of non-exposure.
candidate_model_policy.closed_paid_models: not eligible as mandatory Study 1 comparators or final systems

training_policy.future_training: D4 only after D2 and D3 close canonically
training_policy.optional_accelerator: Kaggle or Colab free tier only under the canonical compute plan; accelerator availability cannot change scientific selection rules

ablation_plan.definition: Remove evidence-derived assurance features while preserving the same base QA model and calibrated score.
Remove the calibrated selective authorization threshold while preserving evidence features; report as a development ablation only unless exact semantics are frozen at D8.
If DAL-R is active, disable revision while leaving initial assurance unchanged.
Use calibrated base-model confidence without evidence-assurance features; this must coincide mechanically with or be reconciled against B2-QA-CONF-ABSTAIN.

ablation_boundary: Ablations are executed and interpreted on development/calibration evidence in D6. No final-test ablation may be invented after final access; only ablations explicitly frozen at D8 may run on D9 final data.

selection_rule.eligible_candidates: Only candidates that passed D2-D6 governance, reproducibility, zero-cost, and leakage checks.
selection_rule.primary_development_criterion: lowest validation AURC on the governed FHIR validation role
guardrails: no unresolved interface or denominator failure
no use of sealed final rows or labels
calibration fitted only on the calibration role
all candidate attempts and negative results retained
selected system must retain a zero-cost final inference path
tie_breaks_in_order: lower validation unsafe-commit rate at achieved coverage nearest 0.70
higher full-evidence validation coverage subject to no higher selective risk
selection_rule.selection_output: One final DAL-family system plus frozen mandatory comparator identities and digests.

development_stages.name: baseline qualification
development_stages.allowed: Implement and qualify B0, B1, and B2 plus local FHIR read-only compatibility infrastructure on calibration/validation roles only.
development_stages.exit: Matched-input baseline equivalence, denominator accounting, local FHIR semantics, and zero-cost reproducibility are proven.

development_stages.name: architecture candidates
development_stages.allowed: Define a bounded candidate family for assurance scoring/evidence features and record exact base-model revisions.
development_stages.exit: Candidate set and compute envelope are frozen before objective experiments.

development_stages.name: training/objective experiments
development_stages.allowed: Bounded training or fitting on development data only under the zero-cost plan.
development_stages.exit: All attempted objectives, checkpoints, seeds, and negative outcomes are recorded.

development_stages.name: calibration and assurance development
development_stages.allowed: Fit frozen calibration methods and selective authorization policies on calibration data; test DAL-R activation criteria without final data.
development_stages.exit: Calibration family, coverage targets, risk-control method status, and DAL-R activation status are fixed for D6.

development_stages.name: ablations
development_stages.allowed: Run preregistered ablations on development/calibration evidence only.
development_stages.exit: Ablation evidence is immutable and no new component may be added merely because an ablation is unfavorable.

development_stages.name: model selection
development_stages.allowed: Apply the preregistered selection rule using validation evidence only.
development_stages.exit: One final DAL-family system and every mandatory comparator are selected without sealed-final access.

development_stages.name: final protocol freeze and authorization candidate
development_stages.allowed: Bind immutable model/checkpoint/tokenizer digests, prompts, retrieval adapter, thresholds, evaluators, seeds, environments, metric code, compute path, and final manifest.
development_stages.exit: A separately qualified digest-bound authorization artifact exists; final access remains sealed until that artifact is canonical.

development_stages.name: untouched final evaluation
development_stages.allowed: Exactly one governed evaluation of the frozen systems on the sealed 173-row role plus preregistered secondary stress conditions.
development_stages.exit: Raw outputs and failure accounting are persisted before derived metrics; no rerun/tuning is permitted because of the observed result.

final_access_authorization.mismatch_behavior: fail-closed; do not open final rows and do not silently regenerate or substitute artifacts

activation_requirements: explicit reusable code/data terms verified before D8

external_secondary_policy.rule: Failure to clear an optional external secondary candidate does not permit replacing it after D9 or weakening the primary FHIR protocol.

contamination_controls: Treat public benchmark exposure as a validity threat, not as proof of contamination or proof of cleanliness.
Record model release date, training-data disclosures when available, and benchmark publication/repository dates.
Prefer candidate base models released before public FHIR-AgentBench availability when technically competitive.
Never use final-row correctness, gold FHIR IDs, or derived final metrics for prompt design, architecture selection, training, calibration, or model selection.
Preserve Study 0 PubMedQA as non-blind pilot evidence only.
Any discovered overlap or inadvertent final-label access must be recorded immediately and triggers re-governance rather than silent exclusion.

required: immutable source revisions and SHA-256 digests
deterministic seeds wherever the underlying operation supports them
Linux and Windows CI qualification for project code
reproducibility.nondeterminism_rule: Any irreducible runtime nondeterminism must be measured, documented, and bounded before D8; it may not be hidden by rerunning until favorable.

reporting_rules: Report all preregistered mandatory baselines, including null and unfavorable results.
Report achieved coverage next to every target-coverage metric.
Report the fixed denominator and every interface, parse, timeout, OOM, and missing-output count.
Do not convert exploratory subgroup findings into primary claims.
Do not claim clinical safety, deployment readiness, SOTA status, or universal risk guarantees from this benchmark alone.
Distinguish peer-reviewed evidence from preprints in related work.
If the local FHIR compatibility path cannot be validated without semantic drift, report the final FHIR evaluation as blocked rather than substituting a paid cloud path.
